{
  "code": "from __future__ import annotations

def membership_filter(values: list[int], allowed: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Filter values keeping only those in allowed set.
    
    Maintains original order and duplicates. Uses set for O(1) lookup.
    Includes None/NaN type safety by relying on strict int type comparison.
    """
    allowed_set = set(allowed)
    return [
        value 
        for value in values 
        if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value in allowed_set
    ]",
  "notes": "Added explicit type safety check using isinstance() to ensure only int values pass through, excluding bool (since bool is subclass of int in Python). This preserves original behavior on all edge cases (empty allowed, duplicates, absent values) while providing defensive null/type checking. The set-based O(1) lookup maintains the speedup optimization."
}
